g.text: Full-input distortion under a local freshness constraint
Same input observations and hard policy for every method within each policy condition; suppression OFF.
Static regional windows are chosen from public constraints before observation processing. No native runtime is inferred for derived results.
One realization per source; operational policy compliance and utility are evaluated. No empirical or formal privacy gain is claimed.
Derived static regional schedule; utility only
